strategy_lines.label: Audience
strategy_lines.text: US community and regional banks with $1B to $10B in assets, in the Mid-Atlantic and Midwest, running Jack Henry or Fiserv cores. Roles: CISO, CIO, Chief Risk Officer.

strategy_lines.label: Offer
strategy_lines.text: The Examiner Readiness Review. A 45-minute session that maps the bank's detection coverage to the FFIEC examination handbook and hands back the three gaps an examiner will flag first. CTA: Book the review.

strategy_lines.label: Message
strategy_lines.text: Halvern is the only managed detection service built on the FFIEC handbook, so every alert maps to an exam finding before the examiner arrives. Proof: 14 banks passed their last exam with zero detection findings on Halvern.
